title: Made an interactive 16th-Century atlas of game dev techniques
author: HugoDzz
selftext: [The Atlas](https://www.spritefusion.com/game-dev-atlas). It's a WIP, I'm adding techniques as I work through them myself (right now focusing on pixel art). I spent WAY too much time on art directing this thing, there is a making of as well for those interested!
